9.7.3. qnav.measurement.error_properties

9.7.3.1. error_properties.py

summary:

Contains representations for sensor error profiles. Module contains classes that are used for profiling the common error types represented by various sensor types. Namely used to reduce repeated common class arguments and methods.

authors:
Prof. Jason Ralph - jfralph@liverpool.ac.uk
Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk
version:

1.0.0 - First full implementation of module.

Defines common error properties used for 3D sensors. This data class contains the errors associated with 3D sensors; specifically, the bias error, bias drift rate, scaling errors, non-orthogonality and measurement noise properties. These are commonly used when defining sensors such as accelerometer and gyroscope, along with their quantum counterparts.

property bias_error: ndarray

The bias errors for each axis (in micro-g).

Returns:

Sensor bias errors (in micro-g).

Return type:

np.ndarray (3-elements)

property bias_drift_rate: ndarray

The bias drift rate for each axis (in micro-g/root sec).

Returns:

Bias drift rate (in micro-g/root sec).

Return type:

np.ndarray (3-elements)

property scale_error: ndarray

The scaling errors for each axis (in ppm).

Returns:

Scaling errors (in ppm).

Return type:

np.ndarray (3-elements)

property non_orth_error: ndarray

The non-orthogonal “cross-coupling” errors (in micro-g). Specifically the alignment errors for axis xy, xz, yx, yz, zx and zy respectively.

Returns:

non-orthogonal errors (in micro-g).

Return type:

np.ndarray (6-elements)

property avg_meas_noise: ndarray

The average measurement error for each axis (in micro-g.root Hz).

Returns:

average measurement error (in micro-g.root Hz).

Return type:

np.ndarray (3-elements)

property error_matrix: ndarray

A matrix containing the scale factor and cross-coupling errors for a nominally orthogonal sensor. This is a commonly used representation. For scale errors S and non-orthogonal errors M, this is formatted as: [[ Sx, Mxy, Mxz ],

[ Myx, Sy, Myz ], [ Mzx, Mzy, Sz ]]

Returns:

Error matrix for scale factor and cross-coupling errors.

Return type:

np.ndarray (3-by-3 elements)
